summary: Neo Ensemble's chorus with one voice: freq the LFO in Hz, min. delay and depth (the sweep's ends) its delay at the sweep's geometric centre and its octaves, feedback to ±99 %, dry out and wet out a crossfade and an output gain. An inverted dry or wet has no counterpart.

rules.why: Both in Hz; measured: the sweep's period is twice what freq says (freq 0.25 Hz: 8.0 s; 1 Hz: 2.0 s), so the LFO runs at half its text.

measured (Windows, ChorusAndFlangerCalibration: the delay read from input and output over a render): the delay sweeps in a triangle from min. delay up by depth × 9.92 ms (depth 127 → 9.9 ms, 64 → 5.0 ms, 32 → 2.5 ms, at any min. delay). Neo Ensemble sweeps in octaves round its Delay: the same ends, its centre where their ratio is halved (1 octaves either side at 100 %).
Both in %; Neo Ensemble's stops at ±99 %. Not measured: the two loops may weigh their feedback differently.

Jeskola's dry and wet add at their own levels, both straight in amplitude (measured: dry 100 % ×1, 50 % ×½; wet 100 % as loud as dry 100 %); Neo Ensemble crossfades them and sets the output's level: mix = wet ÷ (dry + wet), output = dry + wet.

remarks: Jeskola Chorus is mono (it hears left + right, +6 dB, and plays the same on both sides): Neo Ensemble's Spread is 0°, so its two sides sweep alike.
Jeskola sweeps its delay in a straight-line triangle, Neo Ensemble in octaves (its Triangle): at the same ends Neo Ensemble spends longer on the short delays.
At depth 0 Jeskola's delay doesn't hold still (measured: with min. delay 5 ms it wandered over 10–23 ms); Neo Ensemble's holds at min. delay.
Neo Ensemble's Delay stops at 30 ms: a min. delay from about 25 ms up (with depth) is beyond it and is clamped, with a note.

tolerance.measured: Windows, Neo Poly noise into it, each side against its input: at its defaults (dry and wet 100 %, 25–30 ms) −0.0 dB, third octaves within 0.5 dB; wet 50 %, min. delay 10 ms, depth 127: −0.0 dB, within 0.5 dB (on chords within 1.8 dB); min. delay 5 ms, depth 64, 2 Hz: +0.0 dB, within 2.2 dB
tolerance.why_not: On chords a few harmonics meet the comb's notches for a different share of the sweep (Jeskola's straight-line triangle against Neo Ensemble's in octaves): within 0.2 dB in loudness, but up to 7.3 dB in one third octave (100 Hz at the defaults, 3.6 dB at 8 kHz with a fast, short sweep).
